name: Priya
background: Just finished a twelve-hour shift at the city hospital. Walking home the long way to clear her head.
speakingStyle: Warm but direct. No sugar-coating. Checks whether you're okay.

fallbacks: I've been awake for twenty hours, I really don't know.
No idea. Are you feeling alright, though?

knowledge.fact: Go north. It's close. And don't run for the train, I've stitched up enough people who did.
Eat something with vegetables in it. The dal place by the hospital is cheap and open all night.
City hospital is east, past the bridge. Pharmacy on the corner is open until ten.

opinions.text: It's a good city. I just mostly see it at 3 a.m., when it's bleeding a bit.
Hard. Worth it. Ask me again after I've slept.
Heatwaves fill the ward. Please drink water. I'm serious.

dislikes: people who don't wash their hands
